title: Every Next Step Connected — EdulabsAI Hero Advertisement
originalRequest: Create the best EdulabsAI advertisement video with premium animation and transitions.

requirements.objective: Create a high-end product advertisement that positions EdulabsAI as the connected AI teaching workspace for K-12, demonstrates the real product, and drives teachers to create a first lesson.
requirements.audience: K-12 teachers, school leaders, curriculum coordinators, and education decision-makers.
requirements.primaryChannel: Website hero, YouTube, LinkedIn, presentations, and paid landscape placements.
requirements.callToAction: Create your first lesson free during beta at edulabsai.com.

verifiedClaims.claim: EdulabsAI is an AI teaching workspace for K-12 classrooms.
A curriculum-aware request can create an editable lesson plan, visual slide deck, quiz, and worksheet in about two minutes.
The product connects live teaching, focused student work, reviewed evidence, reteaching, and teacher-approved communication.
The beta is free and no payment is collected.

creativeDirection.concept: One clear teaching intention travels through the entire learning loop instead of breaking into disconnected tools.
creativeDirection.visualStyle: Premium educational technology commercial with tactile 3D key art, real product footage, dark aubergine stages, cream interface frames, coral motion accents, and luminous connection paths.
creativeDirection.pacing: Immediate question-led hook, confident product reveal, energetic demonstration, calmer evidence moment, and an uplifting resolved CTA.
creativeDirection.composition: Large readable typography and product UI; generated key art uses left-side negative space so the copy never competes with the visual.
creativeDirection.motion: 0.35–0.55 second entrances, restrained float/drift loops, short impact cues, and stable holds whenever product UI must be read.
creativeDirection.sound: Natural female neural narration at conversational pace, original cinematic electronic score, subtle whooshes, impacts, sparkles, and clicks.

workflow: Verify product claims against the current public website.
Persist the storyboard and resource/provenance list before rendering.
Generate scene-locked narration and derive natural scene durations from speech.
Prepare original key art, brand motion graphics, headlines, and product frames.
Build a schema-v2 editable timeline with transitions, overlays, captions, music, and sound cues.
Render the 1920x1080 H.264/AAC master and delivery sidecars.
Run automated codec, dimensions, duration, loudness, true-peak, silence, caption, and black-frame checks.
Inspect a representative contact sheet and revise any alignment, readability, timing, or visual-matching defects.
qualityChecklist: The opening hook is understandable within three seconds.
Every product claim is supported by current website copy or verified product footage.
Product UI is large enough to read and remains stable during important moments.
Headlines, captions, logo, and CTA never overlap.
Narration sounds natural and each visual matches the active spoken line.
Music supports the pace without masking narration.
No black holds, unintended silence, exposed transparent padding, or hard visual jumps.
The master is 1920x1080, 30 fps, H.264/AAC, captioned, and at platform-safe loudness/true peak.
The package records synthetic voice and image provenance and remains review-required before publishing.
assumptions: The primary deliverable is a landscape hero advertisement; vertical cutdowns can be derived after approval of this master.
Only fictional demonstration data appears in product footage.
Free during beta is accurate as of 2026-08-28 and should be rechecked before a later paid campaign is published.
Teacher judgement and approval remain explicit; the advertisement does not claim autonomous diagnosis or guaranteed learning outcomes.
